definitions.explanation: An involuntary spasm of the diaphragm that causes a sudden intake of breath, producing a characteristic sound.

examples.japanese: しゃっくりが{止|と}まらない。
{急|いそ}いで{食|た}べたらしゃっくりが{出|で}た。
examples.english: I got hiccups because I ate too quickly.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}を{飲|の}んだらしゃっくりが{止|と}まった。
examples.english: The hiccups stopped after I drank some water.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- しゃっくりが{出|で}る (to get hiccups)
- しゃっくりが{止|と}まる (hiccups stop)
- しゃっくりが{止|と}まらない (hiccups won't stop)
- しゃっくりを{止|と}める (to stop hiccups)

FOLK REMEDIES:
- {水|みず}を{飲|の}む (drinking water)
- {息|いき}を{止|と}める (holding breath)
- {驚|おどろ}かせる (surprising someone)
